name: Hoco HC4 Bella Sports BT Speaker – Portable & Powerful
description:
Brand: Hoco
Colour: Black
Country of Origin: China
Type: Bluetooth Speaker
Battery Life: Up to 3 hours
Driver Unit: 52mm x2
Connection Types: BT, FM, TF card, USB flash drive, AUX, TWS
Model: HC4
Amplifier Power: 5W x2
Battery Capacity/Voltage: 1500mAh

Product Summary:
The Hoco HC4 Bella Sports BT Speaker delivers rich sound and solid bass, perfect for sports lovers. Its sleek and portable design makes it ideal for outdoor activities, while offering multiple connection options for convenience. Enjoy immersive audio and reliable battery life wherever you go.

Key Features:

Superior Sound Quality: Dual 5W amplifier power ensures clear and deep sound for music, podcasts, and calls. Ideal for sports and outdoor entertainment.

Battery Life: Equipped with a 1500mAh battery, providing up to 3 hours of continuous playback—perfect for trips and outdoor events.

Multiple Connectivity Options: Connect via Bluetooth, FM, TF card, USB flash drive, or AUX for maximum versatility.

TWS Feature: Pair two Hoco HC4 units using True Wireless Stereo (TWS) for stereo sound.

Portability: Compact and lightweight, easy to carry while running, hiking, or traveling.

Stylish Design: Sleek black finish adds a sporty and stylish look to your outdoor adventures.
